summary: Every filter narrows the list and never reorders it. Among the businesses left, those whose name, categories or services match the words or the category asked for come before those that match only in their description. Then comes reach: members whose inbox answers, ours or any compatible inbox; then businesses with other live agent doors, by what an AI can do through them, payable before bookable or orderable before askable; then the rest. Within each, businesses whose record of kept promises reaches 0.40 come by that record, and everyone else takes turns in a shuffle that changes once a day and that anyone can reproduce. Every 5th place of the full list goes to an answering newcomer. A business has one place in a list. Distance is a filter; an assistant may ask for the nearest instead. Nothing about the order can be bought, and a free self-hosted inbox ranks the same as ours.

order.snapshot: frozen every hour at :00 UTC for members and listed entries alike (dir_entries); entries the crawler found are kept 7 days, members' for ever
order.cursor: base64url JSON {m: "v7"|"v7near"|"nearest", o}: the place reached, continued in the current hour's order, so across :00 an entry may repeat or be skipped; at most 1000 places deep
order.filters: category, attributes, near and radius_km, country, open_now, language, price_band, accepts, requestable, door_type, level, has_inbox, source and item_type only leave businesses out; the rest keep the order. q leaves out every business whose text lacks one of its words, and sets the band of each one it keeps (bands). category is a group slug of GET /v1/categories or an Overture place category id (with every category below it), found by its id, slug, label or synonym, ignoring capitals and accents; an unknown one is 400 category_unresolved with up to 5 candidates. attributes are keys of GET /v1/attributes, all of which must hold. country keeps a business located in that country, serving it, or shipping there. accepts keeps a business whose live doors take every kind named (ask, quote, book, order, pay) and that accepts every payment named. requestable keeps a business with a live door that declared that kind. door_type keeps a business with a live door of any type named. level keeps a business at that level or above; below askable nothing is listed yet. has_inbox keeps a business with an inbox door, or without one. source keeps members, registered or found businesses. language keeps a business that speaks that language or a variant of it, page language included. open_now keeps the businesses open at that moment by the hours they published in their own time zone; a business without hours is left out. Distance is a filter: near keeps businesses within radius_km.
order.rule: Filters narrow, never reorder. Band 1 = the words or category match its name, categories or services; band 2 = matches only its description. Reach 1 = a member's inbox that answers (ours or compatible; signed ping within 24 h, checked within the last 7 days). Reach 2 = other live doors by level (Payable > Bookable/Orderable > Askable). Reach 3 = Readable/Listed (index only until Phase B). Then kept promises (receipts score ≥ 0.40). Then a daily shuffle. Every 5th place goes to an answering newcomer. One place per business. No score steps and no embedding "meaning" fallback in v1. Distance is a filter; `order=nearest` is optional. Owners see only level, proof and record.

bands.1: every word of q is in its name, its categories' labels and synonyms, its services' names or its tags; with no q, every business is in band 1
bands.2: every word of q is in its text, but not every word in band 1's
bands.computed: at query time, over the hour's order

reach.1: a member whose inbox sent a signed ping within answering_hours (24) and whose manifest this network fetched successfully within the last 7 days
reach.2: a business with a live agent door at askable or higher, by its best live door: payable, then bookable or orderable, then askable; a member whose inbox does not sign its pings, or was not checked in the last 7 days, is here at its inbox's level
reach.3: readable or listed: kept in the index and not served until Phase B; a listed member whose inbox is unreachable is served here until it is set aside (rules version 5)

order.within_reach: those ranked by their record (score ≥ 0.40, compared as rank_score_int), then the daily shuffle over everyone else and over ties, then id

newcomers.who: a business in reach 1 that is not ranked and became a member less than 90 days before the hour's order
newcomers.how: places 5, 10, 15… of the hour's order go to the next newcomer not yet placed, once, when the order is frozen; a newcomer may also come earlier in its own place; never twice. A search narrows that order, so a newcomer keeps its place among the businesses a filter leaves

order.one_place: two entries on the same registrable domain (the public-suffix list with private suffixes) take one place, the better one; a member always takes the place of an entry the crawler found on its domain
order.nearest: order=nearest with near sorts the filtered businesses by distance, then rank_pos; no newcomer places
order.found_tier: Businesses this network finds on their own websites are listed only when they are askable or above, with each fact's source and date and the words: found on its own website · not a member · checked <date>. Until version 7 takes effect, they and businesses registered without an inbox appear only in a separate tier after every member, in their own order (reach, then the daily shuffle), so no member's position changes.
order.sources: a value counts in a filter only when the business declared it (its manifest, its registration, its own structured data) or it is seen on its own pages or at its own door; a value marked probably never counts in a filter, except page language, shown with ~

changelog.summary: Rules 0.2.0: the directory lists agent-ready businesses with their doors. A search's words or category put businesses whose name, categories or services match before those matching only their description. Reach orders the rest: a member's inbox that answers, then other live agent doors by what an AI can do through them. Kept promises and the daily shuffle work as before, every 5th place of the full list goes to an answering newcomer, and a business has one place. Businesses found on their own websites are listed when askable or above, labelled as found, and until this version takes effect only after every member. Published with 15 days' notice.
